summary: Deterministic proto-json-v1 payload codec seam for protocol transport planning.
claim_boundary: Payload serialization seam only. This slice encodes validated protocol event envelopes into deterministic proto-json-v1 bytes for broker payload sizing and budget enforcement. It is not protobuf code generation, live broker publish, gRPC network I/O, async runtime work, process supervision, deployment, or delivery guarantee evidence.

facets.F1_simplicity: The codec stays in the existing protocol transport kernel and reuses validated ProtocolEventEnvelope values instead of introducing a framework or external serializer.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: Actual encoded byte sizing before publish planning enables later broker/gRPC workers to enforce payload budgets deterministically at scale.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover canonical encoded fields, byte-length agreement, JSON escaping for quotes/backslashes/control chars, null idempotency, and payload budget refusal.
facets.F4_api_contract: The public surface adds ProtocolPayload and encode_protocol_payload while preserving plan_transport_from_envelope, plan_broker_publish, plan_grpc_unary, and recording executor contracts.
facets.F5_quality: Focused transport-kernel tests plus the 42-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/source validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: ProtocolPayload exposes encoding, encoded bytes, byte_len, and max_payload_bytes so future runtime publishers can log size and reject over-budget payloads before I/O.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The codec serializes protocol metadata refs only; it does not add raw message/mail/post body content, credentials, broker URLs, database URLs, or principal secrets.
facets.F8_supply_chain: No new dependency is introduced; JSON escaping is deterministic local code inside the existing workspace crate.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for 9 transport-kernel tests and the broad backbone matrix passed 268 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: The transport kernel remains present in GitHub Actions and all four Jenkins package matrices; this slice preserves matrix coverage without claiming remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: Encoded payload byte length and budget metadata can later feed payload-size and budget-rejection telemetry for broker/gRPC workers.
facets.F13_reversibility: The change is localized to the existing transport kernel plus task/evidence documentation; reverting restores symbolic byte estimation without touching REST/app/outbox/runtime crates.
